eyebrow: Make room for what you remember
intro: Capture what stays with you after waking. Explore images, feelings, and connections to your own experience.
step1body: Tell the dream just as you remember it.
step2body: Pay attention to details and feelings.
step3body: Find your own question to explore.
formSub: You don't need every detail. Begin with a scene.
placeholder: I was in a familiar house, but beyond the door was a completely different world…
exampleText: I dreamed about my grandmother's old house. She gave me a small key. I opened a door and found a room filled with clear water. When I woke up, I felt peaceful and curious.
recurring: This dream or storyline has happened before
languageHelp: Choose the language of your text. It does not determine nationality or beliefs.
culture: Cultural context that matters to you
culturePlaceholder: Only if you would like to share it
cultureHelp: Optional. Stored without interpretation in this demo; we never infer your religious perspective.
privacy: Submitted dreams stay in this computer's local database; no AI reflection is requested. Voice recognition uses your browser's separate service.
demoBody: AI is not connected yet. You will see matched words and a reflection template, not a personal interpretation.
disabled: Reflections are disabled. Set AI_MODE=demo and restart the API to try the local demonstration.
processingSub: The stages below reflect the actual task status on the server.
extracting: Looking for words in your text
deleted: The dream and its result were removed from the local database.
noSymbols: The demo did not find words from its small list. This is a limitation of the example, not a statement about your dream.
question: A question for yourself
futureBody: Full reflections are still in development. Payments and subscriptions are unavailable.
disclaimer: A space for reflection. Not a prediction or diagnosis.
approachBody: Your account and your associations matter. The research library is an internal foundation; retrieval from it is not connected yet. A cultural perspective can only be your voluntary choice.
footer: Sonnic · Begin with what you remember

errors.connection_failed: Could not connect to the API. Check that the local server is running and try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check your dream length, date, and the fields you entered.
errors.session_required: Your guest session expired. Start a new entry.
errors.dream_not_found: This entry was not found or is unavailable in this session.
errors.rate_limited: This session reached the local limit of 10 new dreams per hour. Try again later.
errors.provider_not_configured: Real AI is not configured. Only explicitly enabled demonstration mode is available.
errors.idempotency_conflict: The request changed. Start a new entry.
errors.interrupted: The server restarted before finishing. You can retry processing.
errors.timeout: Processing took too long. Try again.
errors.processing_failed: The result could not be prepared. Try processing again.
errors.retry_exhausted: All three attempts were used. Start a new entry.
errors.poll_timeout: The result is not available yet. Your entry is saved — check its status again.
errors.unknown: The action did not complete. Please try again.
errors.provider_auth: OpenAI rejected the access settings. The app owner needs to check the key and model access.
errors.provider_rate_limited: OpenAI temporarily limited requests or the API budget was exhausted. Try later.
errors.provider_unavailable: The AI service is unavailable. A demo was not substituted for your reflection.
errors.provider_refused: AI could not process this request. It will not retry automatically.
errors.invalid_model_output: The AI response failed format or content checks and was not shown. You can retry.
errors.safety_support: Your account may describe immediate danger while awake. Support matters more than dream interpretation right now: contact someone you trust, and local emergency services if there is an immediate threat.
errors.safety_refused: This request cannot be processed as a safe dream reflection.

realBody: OpenAI reflects on your account. This is a possible interpretation; research-library retrieval is not connected yet.
privacyReal: Submitting sends your dream text and supplied context to OpenAI for reflection. The dream and result are also saved in the local database. Voice uses a separate browser service.
noSymbolsReal: Distinct images could not be identified reliably. Try adding dream details.
composingReal: Creating and checking a possible interpretation
